_what: Where ARRANGE finds its tools on this machine. Copy to ~/.config/arrange/config.json (or point ARRANGE_CONFIG at it) and edit. Every key is optional; docs/setup.md lists each one with its environment variable.

python._what: analysis: librosa, pretty_midi, soundfile, music21, verovio, pedalboard, pyloudnorm. soulx: the SoulX-Singer requirements plus g2p_en. plain: any Python 3.10+. Each defaults to the Python running the script.
